title: Signal Portfolio — Quarterly commitment log
content:
Quick note:
This is a working scratch for the quarter — combines a compact set of commitments, the concrete signals I will collect, and short manager/skip-level prep scripts. Keep it informal: shorthand, TODOs, half-formed hypotheses. Goal is to have a single place to pull examples from for my quarterly review and 1:1s.

Context / role focus (one sentence):
Lead individual contributor in People Ops focused on career frameworks, performance calibration tooling, and lightweight onboarding improvements for eng orgs. Primary partners: Eng managers, Talent Partners, Growth.

90-day commitments (what I want to own/deliver):
1) Career rubric iteration: ship v0.3 of the engineering career rubric with clear competency anchors for IC2–IC4 and example artifacts for each anchor.
   - success signal: rubric published on Confluence + 5 manager interviews logged (notes attached), initial feedback triage doc completed.
   - target date: 2026-01-20 (slipped from 12/15—scope creep in examples).
2) Calibration toolkit MVP: a lightweight spreadsheet + guidance for managers to run 30-min calibration syncs per pod.
   - success signal: 3 teams trialing in Jan, reduction in time-to-consensus by measured proxy (survey median of perceived clarity from managers increases by 0.4).
3) Onboarding fast-track experiments: two micro-experiments to reduce first-week friction for infra hires (pre-seeded sandboxes + buddy micro-sprint plan).
   - success signal: new-hire first-week TODO completion rate improves from ~62% to ~85% in cohort of 8.

Signals & evidence mapping (how I’ll prove progress):
- Manager interview notes: short bullets with one clear example per manager (attach link to notes doc).
- Artifact count: number of example artifacts produced or curated (target >= 12).
- Usage telemetry: Confluence page views + time-on-page for rubric (baseline: 0 -> target 150 views).
- Trial feedback: structured 3-question quick survey after calibration toolkit run (clear/usable/actionable).
- New hire checklist telemetry: entries ticked in week 1.

Metric snapshot (quick numbers to quote in 1:1):
- Current: Confluence rubric drafts: 2 pages; example artifacts collected: 4.
- Baseline manager confidence (quick survey): 2.6 / 5 across sample (n=12).
- New-hire cohort onboarding completion (last quarter): 62% first-week checklist median.

Manager asks (what I want from you in 1:1):
- Permission to run two paid, small experiments (sandbox infra allocation + small stipend for mentor time) — estimate: $2k total.
- Alignment on escalation path if calibration experiments flag clear mismatch (how much latitude to propose role changes vs. escalate to People + Eng leadership).
- 30-minute block in the next two weeks to do a dry-run of my manager-facing script (practice and get tone feedback).

One-on-one script / bullets (practical phrasing):
- Opening (30s): "Quick sync on my Q1 commitments — three things I'm driving: rubric, calibration toolkit, onboarding experiments. Want to surface where I need unblock/decision today."
- Share progress (1–2 min): top-line signals: artifacts count, manager feedback trend, pilot teams signed up.
- Ask (explicit): "Can I allocate ~$2k to run two micro-experiments? If yes—any guardrails you want me to follow?"
- Risk callout (30s): "If we don't move the rubric forward we risk inconsistent leveling signals in our hiring interviews; toolkit usage will be the test for adoption."
- Quick close (30s): "Any feedback on framing? Anything you want me to prioritize differently?"

Short example evidence snippets I will keep handy (copyable quotes):
- From manager A: "Having concrete artifacts would let me show concrete expectations during TL interviews — currently it's very fuzzy."
- From new hire B: "The sandbox helped me start contributing on day 6 instead of day 18."

Risks / mitigations (quick list):
- Risk: Over-scoped examples take months to produce.
  - Mitigation: publish minimal examples + community-sourcing form for more artifacts.
- Risk: Managers don't run calibration toolkit.
  - Mitigation: embed one-pager + 15-min kickoff facilitation (I will run first 3).
- Risk: Infra resource requests blocked.
  - Mitigation: small-budget alternative (cloud credits + temporary shared sandbox).

Backlog (things to iterate later):
- Automated rubric quiz (self-check for ICs).
- Integrations: link rubric anchors to JD templates in Greenhouse.
- Expand calibration toolkit to include cross-team scoring matrix.

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- TODO: ask Eng payroll for quick estimate on stipend transfer process (finance path).
- Q: who is the canonical owner of interview artifacts for infra? (tag Ethan to confirm).
- TODO: make a one-slide TL;DR for exec readout if asked.

Micro wins / morale log (short):
- 2026-01-12: manager B wrote an encouraging DM — "this is already useful" — saved screenshot.
- 2026-01-28: shipped sample sandbox template for infra team (first user onboarded).

Calendar / timing prompts (for my prep):
- Week before calibration pilot: block 1 hour to build facilitation notes + 30m to sync with manager of pilot team.
- 48h before 1:1: drop top-line metrics email with 3 bullets.

Links & artifacts (quick refs):
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PO/Rubric+v0.3
- Pilot signup sheet (internal): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-pilot-signup
- Manager notes folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/manager-notes-q1
- PR for onboarding sandbox template: https://github.com/redwood-inference/people-ops/pull/214

Tone / framing notes for review:
- Keep language manager-friendly ("helpful examples" not "grading").
- Avoid legalese in public pages; use private notes for sensitive leveling discussions.

Closing: short ritual to keep this alive — after each 1:1 I will add a 1-sentence outcome to this doc (Decision / Next step).

------
Scratchpad area (raw fragments, keep below):
- "If this works we can reduce interview uncertainty by 20%? — hypothesis only, need metric"
- Quick checklist for manager run: 1) pre-read 5 mins 2) 30 min discussion 3) calibration decision & note 4) one action owner.
- Slack thread refs: #people-ops/growth, #eng-manager-sync, thread: "rubric-examples-jan".
- Untagged thought: maybe micro-mentorship stipend should be time-limited (3 months) vs one-off.
- To attach: raw interview notes file (privileged).

(End of working doc)
